## Formatting
- Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/ , and format and present your statement by following the example there.

## Input
- Please format Line 1 as <<Line 1>>

- Please format S as [[S]]

## Output
- Please format Line 1 as <<Line 1>>

## Constraints
- Please format constant numbers as {{constants}} and variables as [[variables]] ( e.g.: {{1}} ≤ length of [[S]] < {{50}} ).

- The constraints says that the length of S is in between 1 and 49, but there are no cases where it is more than 9. Please consider adjusting the bounds or create more test cases that covers the constraints.


{ I hope I did this right :) }

Thank you, @jonas_melo, you did it right!

I'd like to add some more points:

Goal
* Please format all [[variables]]. The $ sign isn't used to format variables on CodinGame.

* Please format "A", "E", "I", "O", "U", "Y", "a" and "z" as {{constants}}.

* Please remove the quotation marks around "a" and "z".

* Consider reformatting the rules as a bullet list to make them easier to read.

Constraints
* Please remove the second constraint. It defines the Fibonacci sequence to use, i.e. it's a definition rather than a constraint.

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newlines from the input for:
  • Basic Word (Test 1)
  • Punctuation and spaces (Test 2)
  • Alphabet Wrapping (Test 3)

* Validator Long (Validator 4): Please modify the case to include one or more digits and one or more special characters, so that it matches Test 4.

* Please create Test 5 and Validator 5 to include all lowercase letters not covered by the existing cases. Test coverage and validator coverage should be assessed separately.

* Please create Test 6 and Validator 6 to include all uppercase letters not covered by the existing cases. Test coverage and validator coverage should be assessed separately.

* Please create Test 7 and Validator 7 where the length of [[S]] is between 10 and 50, and [[S]] consists of a few sentences. This should cover the scenario where letters appear immediately before and after non-letter characters.

Thanks.
